outcome_definition: Outcome = average Tm (C) of one homozygote class under LightScanner small-amplicon melting, before and after internal-oligonucleotide calibration; dtm_* = |difference| between the two homozygotes of one amplicon. 'measured'. tm_predicted is the paper's nearest-neighbour value (a MODEL column inside a measured table). dtm_after is the PHYSICAL separation actually achieved, which is what an HRM genotyping call needs.
